wavelets.name: frame0 base transform
wavelets.interlaced_role: first input frame horizontal plus intra-frame field temporal wavelet

wavelets.name: frame1 base transform
wavelets.interlaced_role: second input frame horizontal plus intra-frame field temporal wavelet

wavelets.name: GOP temporal wavelet
wavelets.progressive_role: coefficient-wise temporal transform of wavelet0 LL and wavelet1 LL
wavelets.interlaced_role: same GOP transform applied after each frame field-horizontal transform
wavelets.temporal_role: GOP lowpass sum in band0; GOP highpass difference in band1

wavelets.name: temporal highpass spatial branch
wavelets.progressive_role: one spatial transform of wavelet2 band1
wavelets.interlaced_role: same branch after per-frame field-horizontal transforms

wavelets.name: temporal lowpass spatial branch level1
wavelets.progressive_role: first spatial transform of wavelet2 band0
wavelets.interlaced_role: same branch after per-frame field-horizontal transforms

wavelets.name: temporal lowpass spatial branch level2
wavelets.progressive_role: second spatial transform of wavelet4 band0; final lowpass image
